characters.name: Giske
characters.prompt: A Norwegian woman from the 1400–1850 era wearing a simple linen underdress and a short homespun skirt (cut unevenly by scissors), her face and hands smeared with soot and tallow. She has a determined yet frantic expression, standing tall with slightly hunched shoulders from labor, hair partially hidden under a worn kerchief.

characters.name: The Widower
characters.prompt: A middle-aged Norwegian farmer from the 1400–1850 period, dressed in practical woolen breeches and a linen shirt, with a vest and a simple hat. He appears cautious and tired, showing a mixture of exasperation and relief on his face.

characters.name: The Thieves
characters.prompt: Two ragged men from rural Norway (1400–1850), wearing simple, patched clothing of earthy tones, carrying small sacks or crude tools. Both appear alert and anxious, ready to flee at any moment.

characters.name: The Priest
characters.prompt: A Norwegian clergyman from the 1400–1850 era, in a dark liturgical robe or long black coat, wearing a simple cap or possibly a white clerical collar. He has a concerned yet firm countenance, holding a small prayer book in one hand.

characters.name: Local Farmer
characters.prompt: A sturdy Norwegian farmer from the 1400–1850 setting, wearing a woolen tunic and trousers with leather shoes. He looks alarmed, possibly carrying a lantern or farm tool, with a rustic landscape behind him.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate the moment Giske, sooty and cut-skirted, stands in a rural Norwegian farmyard (1400–1850). The widower, in traditional work clothes, looks on with relief. The frightened thieves shuffle nearby, and in the background, a small wooden church stands where the priest waits. Capture a rustic, 17th- or 18th-century Norwegian atmosphere with wooden farm buildings, rolling fields, and a faint northern landscape in the background. Lighting is soft afternoon light, showing Giske’s dramatic appearance distinctly.
modernMainImagePrompt: Depict Giske and the widower in contemporary Norway—Giske still humorously sooty and her clothes singed, but now wearing torn modern jeans and a ragged sweater. The widower appears in casual work attire, perhaps a plaid shirt and jeans. The thieves wear hoodies, looking jittery near a modern barn or house. A present-day Norwegian church or building stands behind a lit streetlight. Keep the comedic tension but place it in a modern rural setting.
childMainImagePrompt: Show a friendly, cartoon-like scene in old Norway where Giske accidentally fell asleep cutting hemp. She wakes up in funny torn clothing, her face smudged as though with charcoal. The widower looks kind but surprised. The silly thieves peek out from behind a barn, and a smiling priest with a big book stands in the background. Use bright colors and soft lines, and make everyone look non-scary but playful for a 5-year-old audience.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et bilde som viser Giske i en gammel norsk gård fra omtrent 1700-tallet. Hun er svart av sot og tallow, og skjørtekanten er klippet av. Enkemannen står ved siden av i typiske bondeklær, mens to tyver ser forskremt ut ved låveveggen. I bakgrunnen står en prest klar til å lese fra en bok. Gjengi gårdstunet med trebygninger og et landskap som passer gammel norsk stil.
englishMainImagePrompt: Create an illustration set in old Norwegian farm life (around 1400–1850), featuring Giske with her cut skirt and sooty face, the bewildered widower, and two startled thieves. A Norwegian priest stands at some distance with a small prayer book. The wooden farm buildings, rolling fields, and a subdued northern sky reflect the old countryside. Emphasize the humorous chaos of Giske’s bold presence and the thieves’ fear.
